content.short: ADApools is an independent Cardano resource focused on stake pools, staking, and pool-level ecosystem data.
content.description: ADApools presents itself as an independent website focused on Cardano pools and staking. The project is maintained by Cardano Ambassador Josef, a member of Cardanians, and is positioned as a long-running community resource for following stake pools and related Cardano network activity. Its role is practical: give delegators and ecosystem participants an easier way to inspect pool information from a dedicated staking-focused interface.
